AB 135.summary: Higher education trailer bill adjusting data-sharing agreements, student housing grant reporting deadlines, and basic needs fund distribution rules.

tags.evidence: This bill would require this information to be provided by February 1 rather than July 1, together with an annual report provided for in existing law on student housing data, if applicable.

AB 1350.summary: Changes the Employment Development Department's annual fraud prevention tool assessment report to biennial, starting January 1, 2027.

tags.evidence: This bill would revise those annual requirements to, instead, require the department to analyze and assess the effectiveness of its fraud prevention and detection tools and to submit this analysis and assessment to those committees, biennially commencing on January 1, 2027.

AB 1352.summary: Continuously appropriates 10% of Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund proceeds to the Air Resources Board for community air quality grants, technical help, and incentives.

tags.evidence: This bill would continuously appropriate 10% of the annual proceeds of the fund to the state board to provide funding for purposes of awarding grants, providing technical assistance, supporting community participation, and offering incentives in connection with specified programs to improve air quality, thereby making an appropriation.

AB 1353.summary: Requires the Department of General Services to audit state office space use annually and consolidate space, reserving freed space for UC, CSU and community colleges.

tags.evidence: This bill, by January 1, 2027, and annually thereafter, would require the department to conduct an audit of utilization of state office buildings to determine opportunities to consolidate the square footage of office space given to a state agency, as provided.

AB 1355.summary: Prohibits covered entities from collecting or processing location information unless necessary for requested services, adds notice and policy duties, and bars government agencies from monetizing location data.

tags.evidence: This bill would prohibit a covered entity from collecting or processing the location information of an individual unless doing so is necessary to provide goods or services requested by that individual.
This bill would prohibit a state or local agency, including an agency as defined under the Information Practices Act, from monetizing, as defined, location information.

AB 1356.summary: Requires licensed alcohol and drug treatment facilities to submit added incident information within 30 days and requires the department to issue deficiency notices after resident death investigations.

tags.evidence: This bill, John’s Law, would additionally require a facility to submit to the department, within 30 days of the initial incident, any relevant information that was not known at the time of the initial incident.

If the department identifies any violations of specified licensing provisions during its investigation of a resident’s death, the bill would require the department to issue a written notice of deficiency to the facility.

AB 1357.summary: Exempts guaranteed income payments from income and resource counts for means-tested programs, including Medi-Cal, CalFresh, and CalWORKs.

tags.evidence: Under this bill, to the extent not in conflict with federal law, guaranteed income payments received by an individual would not be considered income or resources for purposes of determining eligibility for benefits, or the amount of benefits, under any means-tested program, and vice versa.

AB 1358.summary: Requires at least 60% of Santa Ana River Conservancy Program project funds to go to urbanized lower-river projects benefiting disadvantaged communities or vulnerable populations.

tags.evidence: This bill would require at least 60% of the funds allocated to fund or undertake the above-described projects to be for projects in heavily urbanized areas, as defined, of the lower Santa Ana River region, as defined, to benefit disadvantaged communities, severely disadvantaged communities, or vulnerable populations.
